Name: Talkohlooey's pastel portraits
Author: geneticmistake
Description:
It started out simply as a few modifications for personal use of [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/talkohlooeys/about-me?gameId=1303]Talkohlooey's[/url]﻿ wonderful art, but I thought other people might enjoy it.
All the characters have coloured lines, the tones are softer and more pastel.I have also redrawn some details just for personal taste.
Now some characters have freckles, ear rings, hoked noses, beauty marks, makeup, scars, wrinkels... you name it.
It include a optional portraits with a more "low resolution" effectThe folder also contains a PSD of one character with all the layers in case someone want to replicate the same process, and a photoshop action for the pixelated style. 
I want to complete this mod with all the vanilla portraits Talkohlooey did, i'll do it one day.
Its my first mod, and I wish you like it.
